function.name: list_files
function.description: List project source file paths. Sensitive and generated files are excluded.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read lines of a UTF-8 source file. Defaults to first 200 lines, max 400 lines. Follow hasMore to read further.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Search a literal string in project source files. Returns matching lines.

function.name: propose_file
function.description: Write a complete source file if task allows edits; otherwise stage it for review. Must read existing file first. Never delete files.

content.description: Complete new file content, not a patch

function.name: update_plan
function.description: Persist a short task checkpoint: goal interpretation, observable acceptance criteria, steps, failures and next action. Preserve facts, not hidden reasoning.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a project verification command. node --test/--check or npm test/run test/build/lint/typecheck/check only. May await approval. Wait for actual exit; running is not success. Use command ID with command_result. No shell, installs, publish or arbitrary scripts.

purpose.description: What user acceptance criterion this validates

retry_id.description: Explicitly retry a failed/interrupted command ID after inspecting its result

function.name: command_result
function.description: Read status and bounded output of a command by ID. Poll running commands before assuming success; do not run them again.

function.name: review_diff
function.description: Inspect applied changes, external conflicts and current project fingerprint. Run after the last modification and after checks.

function.name: finish_task
function.description: Declare completion with evidence. Change tasks require a successful behavioral check against current files and a current diff review. A summary alone cannot complete a task.

evidence.description: Concrete observed evidence and remaining limits
